cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Physically based planetary atmosphere Lut / sky-dome shaders (Nishita 1993, Preetham 1999, Bruneton 2008, Hillaire 2020) requiring deep azure zeniths and crimson sunsets
Spectral path tracing of sub-wavelength Rayleigh opalescence (blue marble glass, milk/colloid Tyndall scattering, and clean glacial ice)
Aerial perspective transmittances where short-wave blue scatters 5.06x to 16.00x more strongly than red
2-multiply (nu^2)^2 evaluation replacing 64-ring dipole Poynting flux integration
not_for: Large water-droplet fog and dense cloud Mie scattering (d >> lambda), which is nearly wavelength-independent
Vacuum space scenes with zero atmosphere
